title: Only 16% Pass This Medical Treatments Quiz
summary: Ten familiar therapies. Can you match each one to what it actually does?

landing.intro:
You’ve heard the names. Do you know what they mean?
Prove it in 10 questions.

about.body:
This ten-question trivia quiz covers treatment names, rehabilitation, talking therapies and hospital care. Look at each original source image and choose one of four answers.

The first ten questions, answer choices and images are reproduced from Log Cabin Daily with permission stated by the site owner commissioning this quiz. The source order and answer key are preserved.

Naming a therapy does not establish whether it works for a particular condition. Evidence, risks and suitability differ between treatments. The headline percentage is promotional wording supplied for this quiz, not a measured pass rate.

howToPlay.title: How to Play
steps: Read each question and study its picture.
Choose the answer that best describes the treatment.
Reveal your score, then unlock a review of the answers you missed.

about.disclaimer: For entertainment and general learning only. This is not medical advice, a clinical assessment or a healthcare qualification. Ask a qualified healthcare professional about treatment decisions.

stage-1.preAdCopy: Your ten answers have been checked. Reveal your score and see which treatment topics you knew best.

profile-1.title: Treatment Trivia Expert
profile-1.copy: You matched almost every treatment to its meaning. Your score shows a strong grasp of these ten terms.

profile-2.title: Therapy-Savvy Thinker
profile-2.copy: You passed this challenge with a good understanding of the treatment names. Review the ones you missed to complete the picture.

profile-3.title: Promising Treatment Spotter
profile-3.copy: You knew more than half of the answers, but a few similar-sounding therapies caught you out.

profile-4.title: Curious Health Learner
profile-4.copy: Some names were familiar; others were harder to place. Your answer review shows which terms you mixed up.

profile-5.title: A Fresh Start
profile-5.copy: Medical terminology can be confusing. Explore your missed answers to learn what these ten treatment names describe.

score.passed: You passed the medical treatments challenge!
score.disclaimer: For entertainment and general learning only. Your score measures answers in this quiz, not clinical knowledge or fitness to provide healthcare.
